text_block_list.text:
Early in the morning on the first day of 
summer training camp, during personal 
practice. Daiichi Ruby notices something 
concerning about KS Miracle's leg.

KS Miracle was well aware of that herself. 
Even so, she reassured that she knew how 
to manage her own body, so everything 
would be fine.

Apparently, K.S.Miracle was naturally 
frail from birth. Yet thanks to the 
devoted support of those around her, she 
gained a body capable of running races.

K.S. Miracle expressed her wish to win a 
GⅠ to repay that great debt. Seeing her 
own circumstances reflected in her, 
Daiichi Ruby sympathized.

However, Daiichi Ruby couldn't shake a 
lingering concern about K.S. Miracle 
pushing herself too hard. —The 3rd year 
summer training camp begins.
